description: Asked the price, the measure and the place, and kept their names off the table.
name: Abraham Sturley

description: Gave the town's side, and did not rescue the sentence or the ear.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Ended the day, and left the field as it stood.
name: Bartholomew Hathaway

description: Enjoyed Quiney's sentence, and left the gentlemen unnamed.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Brought the matter to the house, named two-and-twenty and thirty, and took the giving without the ear.
name: Richard Quiney

description: Marked that the only number said was Quiney's.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Said they should be made to sell, that he had paid none, and that the ear is kept for plays.
name: William Shakespeare
